summary: New tests/integration/test_thread_summary.py — real token-budget truncation over a real long conversation stored in Db2 (THRD-4).
description: THRD-4's get_summary() is unit-tested only with a fake cursor and likely a short fixed message list. Add tests/integration/test_thread_summary.py: seed a genuinely long real conversation (enough working-memory rows/content length to exceed a small token budget, e.g. max_tokens=200) into one scope on the live pool, call get_summary(scope, max_tokens=...) and assert the returned Summary's truncation behavior against the real row set — the included turns actually fit under budget, the truncation boundary is deterministic given the same real data, and a budget larger than the total content returns everything untruncated. Define local fixtures inside this file only.

comments.text: Done. Created tests/integration/test_thread_summary.py — 6 tests: full transcript no budget, budget truncation oldest-first with real data, large budget untruncated, except_last exclusion, empty scope empty string.
